data.name: Omeed
data.gender_notes: Omeed is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word 'omeedan', meaning 'having good fortune, prosperous'. In Islamic culture, Omeed symbolizes the blessings and happiness granted by Allah. The name Omeed carries the meaning “Prosperity, Happiness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Omeed usually hope their child will grow to embody prosperity, happiness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with blessings and divine grace.
data.etymology: Omeed belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Prosperity, Happiness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Omeed total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: أميد
in_arabic.long_meaning: أميد هو اسم مشتق من الأمل والرجاء، ويعبر عن التفاؤل بالخير والنجاح. يرمز إلى الأمل في الله والثقة في قدرته على تحقيق الأمنيات. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم ذكر الأمل والرجاء في عدة مواضع، مما يعطي هذا الاسم قيمة روحية كبيرة.

in_english.name: Omeed
in_english.long_meaning: The name Omeed is derived from the Arabic root 'أميد' (ʾamīd), which means hope or expectation. In Islamic tradition, hope and expectation are considered essential virtues. The name Omeed symbolizes a positive outlook on life and a strong faith in the future. It is often associated with optimism, resilience, and determination. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting its universal appeal and significance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Omeed holds a positive connotation in various Middle Eastern and Islamic cultures, traditionally implying good luck, success, and prosperity. It is a sweet and uplifting name, often used to bestow blessings and positive expectations upon the person who bears it.
data.spiritual_significance: Rooted in the Islamic faith, this name carries spiritual meaning as well. Omeed symbolizes the belief that Allah SWT (Subhanah wa Ta'ala) is the source of our blessings and prosperity. When given the name Omeed, it serves as a constant reminder that all good fortune ultimately comes from Allah, and it is our responsibility to remain steadfast in our faith, live justly and well, and appreciate the blessings bestowed upon us.
